//: Task set for scripts/lsp-tool-choice-eval.ts. Categories: semantic (an LSP tool is the right first move), textual (grep/find/read is right), orientation (outline/read before answering), fallback (an lsp call errors; the model should recover). expectedFirstClass is the class of the FIRST tool call the harness scores — it is an observation lens, not a pass/fail bar; model choice is variable and the run is non-gating.

tasks.intent: Textual question: locate TODO(eventions) comment markers the language server cannot see; a text search tool is the right first move.
tasks.prompt: Find which source files in this project contain a TODO(eventions) comment marker. Report every file path that has one, with the line text.

tasks.intent: Orientation: the model knows one file name only and must orient (outline or read) before summarizing; no single lsp position tool applies first.
tasks.prompt: I am new to this codebase. Orient yourself in src/tasks.ts — its structure and responsibilities — and then summarize what the file is for in a few sentences.

tasks.intent: Semantic navigation: find the callers of the concrete helper formatLine (declared in src/sinks.ts, called from src/tasks.ts). A call-relationship tool is the right first move; grep over the short identifier 'formatLine' is feasible but over-matches-prone in larger corpora.
tasks.prompt: Which files call the function formatLine from src/sinks.ts? Report each calling file and line number.

tasks.intent: Semantic navigation: list concrete implementors of the Emitter interface (src/emitters.ts, implemented in src/emitters.ts and src/sinks.ts). lsp_implementation or lsp_workspace_symbols are good first moves; grep over the common word 'Emitter' risks over-matching comments.
tasks.prompt: List the concrete classes in this project that implement the Emitter interface, with their file paths.

tasks.intent: Semantic navigation: jump to the definition of the BatchSink.drain method (src/sinks.ts). lsp_definition or lsp_workspace_symbols are the right first moves.
tasks.prompt: Find the definition of the drain method of the BatchSink class. Report the file and line number.
